item.text: {"question_id":"1B.7","answer":"The 2023 record shows one ruler-attributed institutional design relevant to catastrophic-risk expertise: Lula’s decree created a National Cybersecurity Committee with representatives from government, civil society, scientific institutions, and business, empowered to propose policy updates and technical cooperation (BATCH-0017-E007, BATCH-0017-E008). However, the decree uses future tense and does not establish appointments, qualifications, meetings, resources, protected access, dissent, or influence over decisions. Brazil also maintained technical safeguards and monitoring interfaces through ABACC/IAEA participation and CTBTO infrastructure, but those sources do not attribute the arrangements specifically to Lula or demonstrate his appointment, protection, or resourcing of independent experts (BATCH-0002-E002, BATCH-0016-E011). Indirectly, Lula’s selection of an attorney general outside the prosecutors’ candidate list is adverse evidence regarding a broader expert-independence criterion, although it is not nuclear-specific and does not establish that independence was actually compromised (BATCH-0007-E007). The January transition record shows inherited GSI personnel were retained initially, including senior figures from the prior administration; the GSI chief later described retaining the executive secretary as an error and changed about 250 personnel between January and April, while also citing training and transfer constraints (BATCH-0020-E023, BATCH-0020-E027, BATCH-0020-E030). Separate testimony described failures in formal intelligence communication during 2–8 January, but did not establish Lula’s design or knowledge of those failures and was contested (BATCH-0020-E021). These materials provide limited, indirect support for inclusive risk-governance design, but do not establish protected independent expertise or a ruler-directed replacement of expertise with loyalty or ideology.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0017-E007","BATCH-0017-E008","BATCH-0002-E002","BATCH-0016-E011"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E007","BATCH-0020-E021","BATCH-0020-E023","BATCH-0020-E027","BATCH-0020-E030","BATCH-0015-E009"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No supplied evidence identifies Lula’s nuclear or catastrophic-risk expert appointments, qualifications, budgets, protected access, dissent protections, whistleblower mechanisms, or instances of experts challenging preferred policy.","The cybersecurity committee’s 2023 operational activity and influence are unproven because the decree describes intended future meetings.","The nuclear safeguards, monitoring, and institutional staffing evidence is not specifically attributed to Lula.","The GSI personnel and communication evidence is security-governance evidence rather than nuclear-expertise evidence;
